ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with minimal high-intensity (white) coverage, estimated at less than 5% of the total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast focal points. The left lobe exhibits a scatter of small circular white dots. The right lobe displays several distinct white crescent-shaped and circular pixel clusters concentrated in the lower-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an approximate obtuse angle of 130-140 degrees and minimal pixel depth relative to the overall fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent low-amplitude peaks. Extreme high-amplitude irregularities and jagged clusters are visible at the distal tips due to biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex upward sweep ending in sharp, upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-intensity white clusters (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes, likely corresponding to past barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive, high-intensity textured biological clusters (barnacles) protruding from both the left and right distal tips. Distinctive white crescent-shaped scarring on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant protrusion of barnacle colonies on the far right edge that alters the expected hydrodynamic profile of the fluke tip.
